column3: the hand clock of the process-group test: its setTimeout method only stores the callback and fires on advance(); it waits for nothing (A277)
source text of a child process the test spawns: setImmediate defers the exit by one event-loop turn, it is not a duration and nothing sleeps
source text of a child process the test spawns: a never-firing keepalive (2^30 ms) that holds the child open until the test sends it a signal; the test waits for the exit event, not for the interval

watchdog of the runGroup helper: cleared on close, fires only when the command hangs and then kills its process group and fails the run; a run that ends normally never waits for it. Removal would need an injected clock in the helper and no test depends on the expiry here

tests/e2e/run.mjs only (the manual harness that runs a scenario with a real model; NOT run by CI; the helper tests tests/e2e/*.test.mjs are a different file and are not covered): one-second supervision tick of its loop; a real session cannot run on a fake clock

tests/e2e/run.mjs only (the manual harness that runs a scenario with a real model; NOT run by CI; the helper tests tests/e2e/*.test.mjs are a different file and are not covered): supervision tick that races the exit event of the lead process, so a normal exit does not wait for it

tests/real-session/smoke.mjs only (the manual smoke harness that calls the real claude CLI; NOT run by CI; tests/real-session/*.test.mjs helper tests are other files and are not covered): sleep helper definition and per-step watchdog (kills the process group on expiry)

tests/real-session/smoke.mjs only (the manual smoke harness that calls the real claude CLI; NOT run by CI; tests/real-session/*.test.mjs helper tests are other files and are not covered): two real 2 s sleeps so the next hook message has a later whole-second timestamp than the question; the product stamps messages in whole seconds and has no clock seam: a KNOWN OPEN SEAM, accepted limit (lead decision)
